__first__ | __next__.description: shared/alarm.js: what goes between two alarms in the banner. __first__ and __next__ are the alarm texts either side. Keep both placeholders; change only the separator between them.

__name__: __alarms__.description: shared/alarm.js: the alarm banner, shown in the top-left corner of a Galactic War scene. __name__ is the mod's name, GW Server Mods; __alarms__ is the list of alarm texts. Keep both placeholders; change only the punctuation and spacing around them, for example to full-width punctuation.

__wording__ (__identifier__).description: shared/alarm.js: one alarm in the banner, for an alarm about one mod. __wording__ is the alarm text; __identifier__ is that mod's identifier, such as com.example.server, which stays as it is. Keep both placeholders; change only the brackets and spacing, for example to full-width brackets.
